title: CLAIM: Rothschilds own all the world's central banks
summary: Viral claim that the Rothschilds secretly own the Federal Reserve and most central banks. Counter-evidence: central banks are publicly/government-owned (Bank of England nationalized 1946; the Fed 'is not owned by anyone' — created by Congress). AAP FactCheck verdict: False. The trope traces to an anonymous 1846 Paris pamphlet and 'Protocols'-era literature.
tldr: AAP FactCheck rates the claim that the Rothschilds own most of the world's central banks 'False': the named banks are publicly owned.
ai_summary:
AI review of the AAP FactCheck article (March 26, 2023), read in full:
- Claim checked: a viral video alleging the Rothschild family owns 16+ central banks including the RBA, Bank of England, US Federal Reserve and ECB. Verdict: False.
- Reserve Bank of Australia: 'wholly owned by the Commonwealth of Australia,' created by act of government in 1911, reorganized by the Reserve Bank Act of 1959.
- ECB: owned collectively by the central banks of EU member countries, decisions by a governing council.
- Bank of England: public institution owned by the government, nationalized by the Bank of England Act of 1946.
- US Federal Reserve: 'not owned privately and is classed as an agency of the federal government,' accountable to Congress.
- The article identifies the claim as a common manifestation of a long-running antisemitic conspiracy theory.
- Record summary verified accurate against the document.
